names.note: Name page 14901 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Святитель Луп епископ Труа, епископ Труа, свт.» — THE PAGE PRINTS THE SEE TWICE AND THE RANK THREE TIMES, which is the source's own doubling and not a transcription slip. «Святитель», «свт.» and both «епископ Труа» are rank and see, and are stripped, and the bare forename is all that is left. `fk.mjs` on «Луп» returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(479)», which is the whole of what this source gives; no year of birth anywhere on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 июля ст. ст. — «Свт. Лупа , епископа Труа (479).»

attestations.note: The day's fifth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. «Свт.» and «епископа» are the `hierarch` and `bishop` written here; NO OFFICE WAS MINTED, the packs carrying «Bishop» and not «Bishop of Troyes», so the see stands in the display name. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/lup*` is empty. HE IS NOT NEW TO THE CORPUS'S PROSE, THOUGH: `palladius-of-scotland`'s life already names him, saying that in 429 pope Celestine sent him and Germanus of Auxerre to the British Isles against the Pelagians, and a `related` row was written in both directions in the same batch for that reason. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
